thesis: KDP is in a clean, confirmed uptrend with strong relative strength, and it is one of the few names holding up in a risk-off tape, which fits the defensive-staples leadership in the regime view. Earnings are already out (2026-11-03) and the 10-Q is filed, so there is no earnings event risk in the swing window, and reported growth and profitability are accelerating with low dilution risk. The setup is only a modest one: reward/risk is 1.6 and the target needs a breakout through the 52-week high, so the thesis rests on a pullback entry inside the zone and not on chasing.
